news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Lowered to "Sell" Rating by Wall Street Zen
news.summary: Wall Street Zen downgraded uniQure from Hold to Sell, striking a bearish note on lingering regulatory uncertainty around AMT-130 even after the stock's sharp 2026 rally.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing continued confidence in the AMT-130 accelerated-approval pathway following Q2 results.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8M and a net loss of $81.1M, ended the quarter with $810.3M in cash (runway into 2030), and reaffirmed plans to file AMT-130 BLA/MAA submissions in the US and UK in Q3 2026 ahead of a September four-year data update.

news.headline: uniQure Stock Upgraded by Wolfe Research on Huntington's Therapy Outlook
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded uniQure to Outperform from Peer Perform with a $65 price target, modeling a 70% probability of success and roughly $2 billion in US peak sales for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized follow-on offering of 5.69 million ordinary shares at $45.50, raising roughly $259 million gross to fund AMT-130 commercialization prep, the confirmatory study, and other pipeline programs.

news.headline: uniQure Provides Regulatory Update on AMT-130 for Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure announced that, following a Type B meeting, the FDA agreed the 3-year Phase I/II data could serve as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 and that a sham control is no longer required in the confirmatory trial; shares surged roughly 70% on the news.

catalysts.label: US FDA BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following FDA alignment that 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval filing, uniQure plans to submit its Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) filing for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: After a successful pre-submission meeting with the UK's MHRA, uniQure plans to file a parallel MAA for AMT-130 in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: Topline 4-year Phase I/II data readout for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to report four-year safety, tolerability and efficacy follow-up data on the 24 patients (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose) in the first two treated cohorts, ahead of the planned BLA filing.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA advisory committee (AdCom) meeting on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Management has said an advisory committee review is plausible given the accelerated-approval pathway and has indicated it welcomes the scrutiny; no meeting date has been set.

pulse: uniQure remains in a strong post-turnaround stretch after the FDA agreed in June 2026 that 3-year Phase I/II data can anchor an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, a shift that sent shares up roughly 70% and drove a string of analyst price-target hikes (Wolfe, Wells Fargo, Cantor Fitzgerald). The company backstopped its plans with a $259M follow-on offering, pushing cash runway into 2030, and Q2 2026 results reaffirmed parallel US/UK regulatory filings for AMT-130 in Q3 2026. The next major catalyst is a September 2026 four-year data update, though a lone Wall Street Zen downgrade to Sell on August 1 shows some residual skepticism around regulatory execution.
